//: HOW A WORD IS SAID, when that is not how it is spelled. The screen keeps the real spelling; only the voice sees these. One word for one word — cues are anchored to words, and narrate.py refuses a substitution that changes the count. Hear one before you trust it: python tools/narrate.py --pack italy-wine --say "Vino Nobile di Montepulciano"
